mapper.select: SELECT b.`id`, b.`merchant_id`, b.`title`, b.`sub_title`, b.`rules`, b.`threshold_amount`, b.`benefit_amount`, b.`type`, lb.`stock`, lb.`starts_at`, lb.`ends_at` FROM gouyu.gy_benefit b LEFT JOIN gouyu.gy_limited_benefit lb ON b.id = lb.benefit_id WHERE b.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND b.status = 1
